# datadog_integration_twilio_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Twilio integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Twilio integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Twilio integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the Twilio integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Twilio, keyed by dataflow id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `twilio_integration_account_basic_auth` (Attributes) The basic authentication method and username configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--twilio_integration_account_basic_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--twilio_integration_account_basic_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.twilio_integration_account_basic_auth`

Required:

- `password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret password or private key. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for password_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.
- `username` (String) Non-secret username or public identifier for the credential pair.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `basic`. Defaults to `"basic"`.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `account_sid` (String) Twilio Account SID that uniquely identifies your Twilio account.

Optional:

- `censor_logs` (Boolean) When enabled, Twilio phone numbers in the `to` field and SMS message bodies are censored for privacy.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `twilio_alerts_logs` (Attributes) Twilio Alert resource logs, which detail the errors and warnings raised when Twilio makes a webhook request to your server or when your application calls the Twilio REST API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--twilio_alerts_logs))
- `twilio_call_summaries_logs` (Attributes) Twilio Call Summary resource logs, covering the metadata and performance of the calls made from your Twilio account. Requires Voice Insights Advanced Features to be enabled on the Twilio account; without it this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--twilio_call_summaries_logs))
- `twilio_cloud_cost_metrics` (Attributes) Your Twilio cost data, so that Twilio spend can be broken down and attributed in [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--twilio_cloud_cost_metrics))
- `twilio_events_logs` (Attributes) Twilio Event resource logs, which record virtually every action taken in your Twilio account, such as provisioning a phone number, changing account security settings, or deleting a recording. Actions are recorded whether they came from the REST API, a user in the Twilio Console, or Twilio itself. [Cloud SIEM](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/) analyzes and correlates these logs to detect threats in real time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--twilio_events_logs))
- `twilio_messages_logs` (Attributes) Twilio Message resource logs for inbound and outbound messages, used to track delivery and troubleshoot message errors. A log is produced when you send a message through the REST API, when Twilio executes a TwiML instruction, and when someone messages one of your Twilio numbers or channel addresses. Message bodies are never collected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--twilio_messages_logs))

Read-Only:
